response.rationale: A and B both describe ticket sales plus payment, and both rest on the same central class, RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1, domain layer, fan-out 25). A comes from community:1, which adds the persistence and payment side around RinkService: BookingRepository (fan-in 10) and PuckPayClient (fan-in 4). B comes from component:business, which has RinkService as its only business class besides DomainError. B's "payment settlement" and A's "online payment" most likely mean the same PuckPayClient-based flow, viewed from different groupings. A is a bit broader because it also names refunds, but the core capability is the same. Confidence is moderate because I could only see the class declarations, not their bodies, and A's community also includes unrelated repositories such as TemperatureRepository and HireStockRepository.
